run.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.view_input(v INT); INSERT INTO dbo.view_input VALUES(1),(NULL),(2); CREATE TABLE dbo.view_sink(v INT)
CREATE SCHEMA other
CREATE VIEW dbo.view_unqualified AS SELECT MIN(v) AS result FROM view_input
CREATE VIEW dbo.view_nested AS SELECT result FROM dbo.view_unqualified
CREATE VIEW dbo.view_local_cte AS WITH view_input AS (SELECT MIN(v) AS result FROM dbo.view_input) SELECT result FROM view_input
CREATE VIEW dbo.[view.with.dot](answer) AS SELECT MIN(v) FROM dbo.view_input
CREATE VIEW dbo.same AS SELECT MIN(v) AS result FROM dbo.view_input
CREATE VIEW other.same AS SELECT MAX(v) AS result FROM dbo.view_input
SELECT result FROM dbo.view_unqualified
WITH view_input AS (SELECT 99 AS v) SELECT result FROM dbo.view_unqualified
WITH view_unqualified AS (SELECT 42 AS result) SELECT result FROM view_unqualified
WITH view_unqualified AS (SELECT 42 AS result) SELECT result FROM dbo.view_unqualified
WITH view_input AS (SELECT 99 AS v) SELECT result FROM dbo.view_local_cte
WITH view_input AS (SELECT 99 AS v) SELECT result FROM dbo.view_nested
SELECT a.result FROM dbo.view_unqualified AS a
SELECT dbo.view_unqualified.result FROM dbo.view_unqualified
SELECT dbo.view_unqualified.* FROM dbo.view_unqualified
SELECT dbo.[view.with.dot].answer FROM dbo.[view.with.dot]
SELECT dbo.same.result AS lo,other.same.result AS hi FROM dbo.same CROSS JOIN other.same
SELECT same.result FROM dbo.same CROSS JOIN other.same
SELECT (SELECT a.result) AS result FROM dbo.view_unqualified AS a
SELECT result FROM dbo.view_nested WHERE 1=0
INSERT INTO dbo.view_sink SELECT result FROM dbo.view_nested
SELECT v FROM dbo.view_sink
DECLARE @v INT; SET @v=(SELECT result FROM dbo.view_nested); SELECT @v AS result
SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF
